 ORDER

This is the fourth (repeat) bail application under Section 439 of Cr.P.C filed by the applicant for grant of bail relating to FIR No. 864/2020 registered at Police Station Piplani, District Bhopal for commission of offence punishable under Sections 420 and 120(B) of the IPC.

Learned counsel for the applicant submits that the applicant is in custody since 12/09/2020 and earlier bail application of the applicant was dismissed as withdrawn by this Court, vide order dated 13/09/2022 passed in M.Cr.C. No. 35465/2022 with a direction to learned trial Court to make all efforts to conclude the trial trial as early as possible preferably within a period of six months from the date of receipt of certified copy of this order.
However, till date the said direction has not been complied with by the trial Court.
Hence, on the ground of delay learned counsel for the applicant prays for grant of bail to the applicant.

On the other hand, learned Panel Lawyer for the respondent/State has vehemently opposed the bail application of the applicant by contending that the applicant is having criminal antecedents of the D.K. Singh vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 21 June, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/109189181/

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: However, pendency of trial is not disputed by the State counsel.

Considering the overall facts and circumstances of the case coupled with the fact that in spite of specific direction given by this Court, vide order dated 13/09/2022 passed in M.Cr.C. No.
35465/2022 to learned trial Court to make all efforts to conclude the trial as early as possible preferably within a period of six months.
Trial Court has not taken any serious efforts to conclude the trail and still the trial is pending.
Without commenting upon the merits of the case, this Court deems it appropriate to allow this application on the ground of delay in trial.
Accordingly, the application is allowed.

Applicant-D.K. Singh is directed to be released on bail on his furnishing a surety bond of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand Only) with one surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of trial Court for his appearance during trial.
It is also directed that the applicant shall comply with the conditions as enumerated under Section 437(3) Cr.P.C.

This order shall remain effective till the end of the trial but in case of bail jump and breach of any of the pre-condition of bail, it shall become ineffective and cancelled without reference to this Bench.

On perusal of status report received from the Office of Principal District and Sessions Judge,
Bhopal, it is apparent that learned Judicial Magistrate, First Class, Bhopal has shown his unawareness regarding any direction to be given by this Court for conclusion of trial within stipulated time period.
